name: DataShop and LearnSphere
summary: A repository of students' step-by-step interaction data from tutors and online courses for learning scientists, with LearnSphere's Tigris tool for building analysis workflows.

license.note: No open license: DataShop's terms limit data to research and forbid redistributing or de-anonymizing it, and some projects add their own terms. LearnSphere's code says "All Rights Reserved".

access_note: A free sign-in; public datasets are open to any signed-in user, private ones on request to their owners.
cite: Koedinger, K. R., Baker, R. S. J. d., Cunningham, K., Skogsholm, A., Leber, B., & Stamper, J. (2010). A Data Repository for the EDM community: The PSLC DataShop. In Handbook of Educational Data Mining. CRC Press. Each dataset gives its own citation.

fits.how: Its step-level data could check the harness's measures against other learners' data, for research.
